jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Full-Stack .NET Engineer | AI Agents & AzureIreland | Up to €90,000

Most “AI roles” still involve adding a chatbot to an existing product.

This one doesn’t.

There are seven specific finance workflows that have already been identified as strong opportunities for AI agents. The first agents have been built and are approaching release. This new engineer will help get them into customers’ hands and shape what comes next.

These aren’t generic copilots looking for a problem. They’re focused agents designed to take established, time-consuming finance processes and execute them properly.

You’ll be working across:

C# and modern .NET
Azure and cloud-native operations
REST APIs and distributed services
Microservices and event-driven architecture
Docker and Kubernetes
React, Angular or Vue
AI-assisted and agentic product development

This is a genuinely hands-on role. They need someone who can move from a rough frontend through to the API, validate assumptions, troubleshoot problems across the stack and explain why they made a particular technical decision.

AI tools will absolutely be part of how the team works. The important bit is knowing what good engineering looks like, so you can tell when the output is useful and when it is confidently wrong. You don’t need years of production AI experience.

You’ll need to be based in Ireland. Dublin-based engineers will generally attend weekly, while there is more flexibility for people living elsewhere in Ireland. Critical Skills sponsorship can be supported.

If you’re a strong .NET engineer who wants to work on AI that solves an actual customer problem, this is worth a conversation.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role:

We are looking for a skilled and ambitious Full Stack Developer to join one of our clients, an established technology consultancy with a strong professional environment and a broad portfolio of projects across different industries.
This is an opportunity to work on modern, business-critical solutions where you will have real influence on architecture, technology choices and how products are built. As a consultant, you will work on projects for different clients and contribute across the full development lifecycle – from technical design and development to integrations, testing, deployment and continuous improvement.
You will join a cross-functional technology environment and collaborate closely with experienced developers, architects, designers and technical leaders. Depending on the project, you may work with technologies and concepts such as Node.js, Java,.NET/C#, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Azure/AWS, REST APIs, microservices, Docker and CI/CD.
There is also an increasing focus on AI-enabled development, automation and cloud-native solutions, giving you the opportunity to explore new technologies and contribute to how they are applied in real-world products.

We are looking for someone who:

Has 3+ years of professional experience as a software developer
Has experience with Node.js, Java and/or .NET/C#
Has worked with modern frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, Angular, Vue or similar
Is comfortable working with APIs, integrations and modern web architectures
Has an interest in areas such as cloud, microservices, AI, automation or DevOps
Enjoys solving complex technical problems and contributing to technical discussions
Holds a university degree in IT, Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field
Communicates fluently in Norwegian 

Experience with Azure or AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD, SQL/NoSQL databases, event-driven architecture or AI/LLM integrations is considered an advantage, but not a requirement.

What our client offers:

The opportunity to work on challenging and meaningful technology projects across different clients and industries
A modern technology stack and the freedom to contribute to technical decisions
Exposure to cloud, AI and modern software architecture
Strong opportunities for professional development, certifications and continuous learning
Collaboration with highly skilled developers, consultants and technology specialists
Competitive employment terms and conditions
A social, international and professional working environment
The opportunity to take on more technical responsibility as you grow

If you enjoy building modern software, exploring new technologies and want to develop your career in a consulting environment where you can have a genuine impact on the solutions you develop, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Platform & Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Outokumpu is accelerating the green transition as the global leader in sustainable stainless steel.

Our business is rooted in the circular economy: our products are made from 95% recycled materials and are fully recyclable. Our stainless steel is used across society—from infrastructure and mobility to household appliances.

We are committed to the 1.5°C climate target and, with up to 75% lower carbon footprint than the industry average, we help our customers reduce their emissions.

Together, we are working towards a world that lasts forever. Outokumpu employs approximately 8,200 professionals in close to 30 countries, with headquarters in Helsinki, Finland, and shares listed on Nasdaq Helsinki. Learn more at www.outokumpu.com.

What you'll do

Design, develop and manage APIs using Azure API Management (APIM)
.
Build integration solutions with Azure Integration Services
(Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Event Grid, Service Bus).
Develop secure, scalable data ingestion and event-driven integration patterns.
Implement API security, authentication, monitoring and lifecycle management.
Automate infrastructure and deployments using Terraform, Bicep and Azure DevOps CI/CD
.
Develop integration components in Python, C#, .NET, PowerShell or Node.js
.
Collaborate with Data Engineering and AI teams to support data, analytics and AI initiatives.
Contribute to integration standards, reusable frameworks and platform evolution.

What we're looking for

Several years of experience in Azure integration, API engineering or cloud data ingestion
.
Strong hands-on experience with Azure API Management
and Azure Integration Services
.
Knowledge of REST APIs, event-driven architecture and API security (OAuth2, Entra ID, Key Vault).
Experience with Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD.
Familiarity with Azure data platforms such as ADLS, Databricks, Synapse or Azure SQL
.
Strong scripting or development skills in Python, C#, .NET, PowerShell or Node.js.
Excellent problem-solving and collaboration skills.

Nice to have

Experience with AI/LLM integrations, RAG or intelligent automation.
Databricks administration and Unity Catalog knowledge.
Experience in manufacturing or other complex enterprise environments.

What We Offer

An opportunity to grow your career in a global company driving sustainable innovation.
A collaborative and inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued.
Meaningful work that contributes to a more sustainable future.
Learning and development opportunities to support your professional growth.
Flexible working arrangements, depending on the role and location.
Competitive compensation and a locally tailored benefits package.
The chance to work with international teams and experts across the organization.

Salary range in Finland: 4,260 to 5,330 gross
. Final offer depends on candidate experience and competence.

📄 Employment Details

3-month probation period
Permanent employment contract

📬 Application

Please send your CV in English.
We appreciate your interest in joining our team and thank all applicants for their submissions. The position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Software Developer - Analyst
jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you curious about modern software development and looking for the next step in your career? At Deloitte Engineering, we are looking for recent graduates and early-career software developers who want to strengthen their technical and problem-solving capabilities while helping us grow our Engineering practice. You will have the opportunity to work hands-on with software development while applying your skills in a consulting environment, working with clients to solve complex business and technology challenges.

With more than 2.700 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Technology & Transformation.

About the team

We, the Engineering offering of Deloitte Technology & Transformation Denmark, are on the lookout for additional team-players for our quickly growing practice of software engineers, architects, cloud consultants, and IT management consultants. We assist our clients, some of the largest companies, agencies, and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics, on the implementation of new cloud-native systems as part of their digital transformation – and we need you to help build their opportunities and meet their challenges!

Together, we will accelerate your career towards becoming a proficient software developer. At Deloitte, we are committed to empowering you throughout your career development. As a new employee, you are assigned a talent manager to support your career aspirations and development. You will also be part of a tech community with monthly meetings in which we share knowledge, investigate new topics, and upskill within relevant technologies and methodologies.

Job Description

As a software developer at the Engineering offering, you will work with many different aspects of development, from writing code to testing it. You will work closely with both clients and internal stakeholders to ensure that our solutions meet their business needs and technical requirements. Our client assignments can vary greatly, but common for all of them are that we strive to work with the technologies that the client prefers. Regardless of the technology, we provide you with the opportunity and tools needed to learn and grow within all of them.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

Developing applications and solutions of all sizes, frequently in Agile settings (SAFE/Scrum). This includes both backend and frontend development.
Assisting in the implementation of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (IaC), and adopting DevOps practices to streamline development workflows.
Building internal capabilities through community tasks, maybe within new business areas.
Joining in on workshops and sales pitches and contributing to proposals for new client projects.

Qualifications

You hold a Master’s degree, preferably within Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Software Development, or another relevant technical field. You are either a recent graduate or have up to 4 years of full-time professional experience, preferably within software development. Experience from student positions, internships, or part-time software development roles is also considered an advantage.
You enjoy applying your analytical and problem-solving skills to technical challenges and are motivated by working both hands-on with software and in a client-facing consulting environment. Furthermore, you are either a native Danish speaker or highly proficient in written and spoken Danish.

What you bring to the team:

Experience in Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript, TypeScript, or one or more other widely used programming languages.
Some experience with modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and test automation.
Some experience with modern system design and software architecture principles.
You have strong analytical skills and a focus on quality and detail.
You are a positive-minded teammate with the ability to work and solve problems in a structured way.
You can communicate and express yourself clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What we can offer you

We highly appreciate the knowledge, experience, and perspectives our consultants bring, and in exchange, we make sure they develop professionally, meet their career goals, and enjoy their time with Deloitte.
Therefore, other than an incredible social calendar, we offer our consultants:
Enrolment in the Consultant Academy, which is our training program for building the essential Consultant skills. The Academy takes you to exciting locations to learn from leading professionals in their respective fields.
Focused career development by assigning you a talent manager who acts as your mentor and guides you in your professional journey in Deloitte.
The opportunity to participate in projects and internal work with our different market offerings to find the right fit for you.

On the social aspect, Deloitte Technology & Transformation is second to none. We offer everything from various sports communities to festivals – not to mention the yearly Trip where all our colleagues come together off-site to create lasting memories.
Additionally, we have a strong sense of belonging and community in Engineering, and we support each other every day to make an impact with our clients and to promote personal and professional development.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?
Click the "I am interested" button
above
if you are ready to join our team.
Send your application, CV, and other relevant documents before the 1st of November, 2026. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.
Expected start date: Before or 1st of January, 2027.

Please do not hesitate to contact Sophus Benee Olsen at soolsen@deloitte.dk if you have any
questions about the position.

Disclosure on the Use of AI:
We want to ensure that all applicants receive fair treatment in our recruitment process. This role is part of a pilot where we are testing an innovative approach to recruitment using AI, and therefore you should not upload a traditional cover letter. We want to be completely transparent about the pilot – Read more here.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.
By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.
